summary: No public dataset found that records rounding dynamics of pseudopod tips or protoplasmic drops together with contractility inhibition and a tension measurement. Image archives offer adjacent material: IDR has 438 images of blebbistatin-treated mammalian cells from compound screens, BIA has one cortical-mechanics study (S-BIAD2611, CC BY 4.0) and two Dictyostelium migration datasets; the Cell Image Library could not be queried. Repository searches for cortical-tension data in amoebae returned zero datasets.
next_step: Compile from the literature the cortical-tension and bleb-retraction measurements for Dictyostelium and mammalian cells under myosin-II inhibition (micropipette-aspiration papers) into one table with raw values, or request the data behind S-BIAD2611; then pre-register a test comparing rounding time constants with capillary-relaxation predictions under inhibited vs active contractility.
obstacles_confirmed: Direct tension measurements are uncommon: no repository hit for amoeboid cortical tension.
Tension values are in papers more often than in the image archives: the only mechanics study found (S-BIAD2611) exposes images, not tabulated tensions.
Cell Image Library has no queryable search endpoint from our checks (404/empty).
